purpose: Re-enter current EntityOS effect authority after parallel movement and isolate the remaining semantic request-binding gap without creating a second F2-WP-105 mutation authority.

coordination.review_only_reason: F2-WP-105 already has one active mutation authority; CLAIM_PROTOCOL permits independent review/falsification but forbids a second mutation authority.

current_authority_binding.note: The current 9.13 attestation explicitly permits the existing active F2-WP-105 lane to consume this tuple as external canonical source identity. This resolves the source-identity part of the earlier review but does not itself execute EffectGate/EffectJournal.

semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.observation: EffectCallIntent contains correlation identity only: return_id, binding_id, invocation_id, tool_use_id, delegation_id and child_identity_sha256. CanonicalEffectAuthorityEvidence mirrors those correlation fields plus authority decision, journal_state and effect_id. Neither type carries the immutable semantic EffectRequest identity that the now-admitted canonical EffectGate actually evaluates.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.canonical_gate_inputs: ENTITYOS_EFFECT_AUTHORITY_PY_API/v1 EffectGate.execute consumes EffectRequest(user_id, session_id, capability, target, argv, expected_generation) and journal generation/lease context.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.risk: F2 can prove that ALLOW/effect_id belongs to correlation call A while still failing to prove that the canonical EffectGate evaluated the exact semantic action/target/capability/argv that executor call A will perform. Supplying those semantics through an unbound closure or mutable lookup leaves a substitution gap between policy authorization and dispatch.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.counterhypothesis: One already-bound F2 identifier such as tool_use_id, invocation_id or child_identity_sha256 may deterministically resolve to an immutable canonical effect request elsewhere.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.counterhypothesis_status: NOT_PROVEN_BY_REVIEWED_ABIS_OR_REPOSITORY_SEARCH; NativeChildBinding binds causal/delegation/result identity but no effect request payload or request digest.
semantic_effect_request_binding_gap.falsifier: Show exact current source and deterministic tests proving that a bound identifier resolves to one immutable typed EffectRequest and that canonical authority evidence plus executor input verify the same request digest before dispatch.
required_successor_contract: introduce or resolve one canonical typed effect_request_id/request_sha256 before authority evaluation
bind the exact EffectGate policy inputs required by ENTITYOS_EFFECT_AUTHORITY_PY_API/v1
echo/verify the same request identity in CanonicalEffectAuthorityEvidence
carry/verify the same request identity at the executor boundary
reject request semantic mismatch before executor invocation
preserve canonical PENDING-before-dispatch and UNKNOWN/no-blind-replay laws

decision.reason: The 9.13 attestation closes exact source identity. The remaining bridge ABI still binds call correlation more strongly than semantic effect authorization. Until one immutable EffectRequest identity is common to gate evidence and executor input, an ALLOW cannot be proven to authorize the exact dispatched semantics.

next_exact_action: The existing active F2-WP-105 mutation authority should consume the exact 9.13 current_epoch_consumption_identity, add/resolve one immutable typed semantic EffectRequest identity shared by EffectCallIntent -> canonical EffectGate evaluation -> CanonicalEffectAuthorityEvidence -> PENDING EffectJournal row -> executor input, and run a deterministic no-real-effect matrix proving: exact semantic request + exact call identity dispatches the permitted stub once; action/target/capability/argv/request-digest mutation dispatches zero times; DENY/REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION/DEGRADE/UNKNOWN and stale authority/source/schema/API identity dispatch zero times; ambiguous post-dispatch failure becomes UNKNOWN and cannot blind-replay; VERIFIED completion still requires separate evidence.
